<thought>To obtain a Diels‑Alder retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using the valid functional‑group name for a carbon‑carbon double bond (“C‑C double bonds”) as the group that is broken in the forward reaction. This should return a suitable Diels‑Alder template, after which I can construct the required JSON route (target → one Diels‑Alder reaction → cyclopentadiene + methyl acrylate as precursors).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
